features.quote: In the village there are quarried caves
many rock-cut installations; among them winepresses, basins and cup marks
features.subtype: rock-cut basins in and outside the village

features.quote: remains of two pools, connected by pipes, dated to the EM period
features.subtype: two pools connected by pipes (possibly a bathhouse)

date.basis: entry dates the pools to the Early Moslem period (1972 salvage excavation)

features.quote: Included in it is the Sheikh Muhamad Tomb
features.subtype: sheikh's tomb (Sheikh Muhamad) in the village core

date.basis: a Muslim sheikh's tomb, listed with houses 'presumably 19th century'

features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 22, p. 152 (citing Tzori 1962: site 52)
features.quote: a sheikh's tomb, south-west of the village
features.subtype: sheikh's tomb called after Khader el-Akhdar

notes: Not coded: the oil press with a rock-cut lower basin on the spur W of the village (a press basin, not a pool); winepresses and vats; the two springs at the site (no spring pool described). s2f4 lies under the western part of a Byzantine church at the village; no direction from the site, so position none. s2f5 and s2f6 are dated L as Muslim sheikh's tombs; the entry gives no other date. No site plan (Fig. 67 is an aerial photo).
